name: Scrambled Eggs
method:
Beat the eggs with the salt.
Melt the butter in a pan over low heat.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently until just set.
Serve immediately.

name: Cheese Omelette
method:
Beat the eggs until smooth.
Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat.
Pour in the eggs and cook until the base is set.
Scatter the cheese over one half, fold and serve.

name: French Toast
method:
Whisk the eggs and milk together.
Soak each slice of bread in the mixture.
Melt the butter in a pan and fry the bread until golden on both sides.
Serve warm.

name: Pancakes
method:
Whisk the flour, milk, eggs and sugar into a smooth batter.
Rest the batter for ten minutes.
Melt a little of the butter in a pan and swirl in a thin layer of batter.
Cook until set underneath, flip, then stack and serve.

name: Flapjacks
method:
Whisk the flour, baking powder and sugar together.
Beat in the milk and eggs to make a thick batter.
Melt a little of the butter in a pan over medium heat and drop in spoonfuls about ten centimetres across.
Cook until bubbles form on top, flip, then stack and serve.

name: Tomato and Basil Pasta
method:
Boil the spaghetti until al dente.
Soften the garlic in the olive oil, then add the chopped tomatoes.
Simmer for ten minutes until thickened.
Toss through the drained pasta and finish with torn basil.

name: Garlic Butter Pasta
method:
Boil the spaghetti until al dente and reserve a little cooking water.
Melt the butter and soften the sliced garlic in it.
Toss the pasta through the garlic butter with a splash of the cooking water.
Stir in the cheese and serve.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
method:
Soften the chopped onion in a large pan until translucent.
Add the beef mince and brown it, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the garlic and chopped chilli and cook for another minute.
Add the chopped tomatoes and simmer for twenty minutes.
Grate the courgette, stir it through and simmer for another ten minutes.
Serve over boiled spaghetti.

name: Egg Fried Rice
method:
Heat the olive oil and soften the chopped onion and garlic.
Push to one side and scramble the beaten eggs in the pan.
Add the cooked rice, ideally cooled leftovers, and stir over high heat.
Season and serve.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
method:
Heat the olive oil and fry the diced chicken until cooked through, then set aside.
Soften the chopped onion in the same pan.
Scramble the eggs, then add the cooked rice and the chicken.
Stir over high heat until hot and serve.

name: Mashed Potatoes
method:
Peel and boil the potatoes until tender.
Drain well and return to the pan.
Mash with the butter and warm milk until smooth.
Season with the salt and serve.

name: Potato Wedges
method:
Cut the potatoes into thick wedges.
Toss with the olive oil, salt and pepper.
Roast at 200C for thirty five minutes, turning once.
Serve hot.

name: Toasted Cheese Sandwich
method:
Butter the outside of each slice of bread.
Layer the cheese between two slices, buttered sides facing out.
Toast in a pan over medium heat until golden and the cheese has melted.
Cut and serve.

name: Tomato Soup
method:
Soften the chopped onion and garlic in the olive oil.
Add the chopped tomatoes and cook down for ten minutes.
Simmer for twenty five minutes, loosening with water as needed, then blend until smooth.
Season with the salt and serve.

name: Bean Stew
method:
Soften the chopped onion and garlic in the olive oil.
Add the chopped tomatoes and cook down for ten minutes.
Stir in the beans and simmer for twenty minutes.
Season and serve.

name: Roast Chicken
method:
Rub the chicken all over with the olive oil and salt.
Tuck the crushed garlic under the skin.
Roast at 180C for about ninety minutes until the juices run clear.
Rest for ten minutes before carving.

name: Lemon Butter Chicken
method:
Fry the chicken until golden on both sides.
Add the butter and sliced garlic to the pan.
Squeeze in the lemon juice and simmer for five minutes.
Spoon the sauce over the chicken to serve.

name: Rice Pudding
method:
Combine the rice, milk and sugar in a heavy pan.
Bring to a gentle simmer, stirring often.
Cook for forty minutes until thick and creamy.
Serve warm or chilled.

name: Simple Flatbread
method:
Mix the flour, salt and sugar into a soft dough.
Knead for five minutes and rest for fifteen.
Divide, roll thin and brush with the olive oil.
Cook in a dry hot pan for two minutes a side.
